description: An overdrive that clips the signal, with a tone control after the clipping and a level control at the end

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is driven into clipping
Sets the level of the signal leaving the module
Tilts the tone of the driven signal, dark at one end of its travel and bright at the other
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: Added to the DRIVE knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the GAIN knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the TONE knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
